description: Uploads a workout file (absolute path) to the user's Suunto account. Waits up to about 20 s and returns { uploadId, status, check: { verified, note? } }: verified is true when status reaches 'Processed'; otherwise note says why (e.g. 'Error', or not finished: poll get_upload_status later). Queued one at a time. Suunto documents only .fit for this endpoint; .gpx is accepted but unverified. Write operation.

description.description: Short title shown in the Suunto app.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .fit or .gpx file.

privacy.description: Visibility. DEFAULT uses the account's setting.

name: upload_workout
title: Upload workout file
